name: com.sina.weibo.sdk.content.FileProvider
description: The Sina Weibo Android SDK declares this private file provider, and YYXX Game's common-share SDK bundles the same class. Its configured paths let sharing flows pass local image or attachment files to another app.
disableEffect: Weibo or YYXX sharing that attaches local files may fail because those files can no longer be handed to the receiving app.
